morphology.pattern_note: peN- 遇词根起首 t 时，t 脱落，鼻音实现为 n：pen- + indas + -an → penindasan。输入将本词标为词根有误；实际词根为 tindas。

word_family.gloss: 压迫造成的结果；另有副本义

senses.zh_definition: 压迫、欺压或强力压制的行为；尤指凭借权力不公正地控制、剥削或限制他人及其自由。
senses.en_definition: The act of oppressing, exploiting, or forcibly suppressing people, their rights, or their freedoms.
senses.nuances: 带明显负面评价，常见于劳工、社会不公及自由受压制的讨论。它是行为名词，不能直接代替动词 menindas。具体指压迫还是镇压，须看宾语与语境。[DBP 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=282080&keyword=penindasan) [词根及派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=tindas)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Laporan itu mendedahkan penindasan terhadap pekerja migran dan menyeru majikan supaya menghormati hak mereka.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该报告揭露了移工遭受的压迫，并呼吁雇主尊重他们的权利。
dual_scenarios.en: The report exposes the oppression of migrant workers and calls on employers to respect their rights.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kalau pekerja dipaksa kerja tanpa gaji, itu dah penindasan.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Jika pekerja dipaksa bekerja tanpa menerima gaji, perbuatan itu merupakan penindasan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 要是逼工人干活又不给工资，那已经是压迫了。
dual_scenarios.en: If workers are forced to work without pay, that's oppression.
spoken_features: kalau 对应较正式的 jika。
dah 在这里强调已经达到某种程度。
kerja 在口语中代替完整动词 bekerja。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah baca laporan tu. Pekerja kat situ dipaksa kerja tanpa gaji.
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah membaca laporan itu. Pekerja di situ dipaksa bekerja tanpa menerima gaji.
messages.zh: 我看过那份报告了。那里的工人被逼着干活，却拿不到工资。
messages.en: I've read the report. The workers there are being forced to work without pay.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Itu penindasan. Tak boleh biarkan je.
messages.ms_standard: Itu merupakan penindasan. Perkara itu tidak boleh dibiarkan begitu sahaja.
messages.zh: 这就是压迫，不能就这么放着不管。
messages.en: That's oppression. It can't just be ignored.

etymology.historical_story: Penindasan illustrates Malay's productive way of naming an action through peN-...-an. Its base, tindas, includes physical pressing as well as oppressive or coercive treatment. That semantic connection makes pressure a useful image for understanding the noun. This is an account of its present morphological structure, rather than a claim about an undocumented borrowing or historical first use. [DBP root entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=tindas)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tindas 是“压人”，menindas 是“实施压迫”，penindasan 把整个行为装进名词框架：压迫这件事。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 这是分量较重的指控性词语。正式投诉或工作汇报中，应说明具体行为，避免只给个人贴上 penindas 的标签。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于讨论不平等权力关系、剥削和强力压制。普通意见分歧或一次合理的工作安排，通常不宜直接称为 penindasan。
